title: Deferred Fixed Annuities Product Specifications: Issue Ages and Premium Limits
content:
**Product:** Deferred Fixed Annuities — the Ashgrove Flexible Premium Deferred Annuity and the Ashgrove SecureRate 3, 5, 6, 7 and 10.
**Issued by:** Annuity Product Management, for the Policyholder Service Center.

The figures below are the issue-age and premium limits of each Deferred Fixed Annuities tier. Ages are the age last birthday on the issue date; the issue-age range applies to the owner and to the annuitant. Amounts are in US dollars.

## Issue ages and premium limits by tier

| Tier | Lowest issue age | Highest issue age (owner and annuitant) | Smallest initial premium, non-qualified contract | Smallest initial premium, IRA contract | Largest total premium on one contract without home office approval |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove Flexible Premium Deferred Annuity | 0 | 85 | $5000 | $2000 | $1000000 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 3 | 0 | 90 | $10000 | $10000 | $1000000 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 5 | 0 | 90 | $10000 | $10000 | $1000000 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 6 | 0 | 88 | $10000 | $10000 | $1000000 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 7 | 0 | 88 | $10000 | $10000 | $1000000 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 10 | 0 | 85 | $25000 | $25000 | $1000000 |

## Additional premiums and payment by draft

| Tier | Premiums after the initial premium accepted | Smallest additional premium | Latest day of month for a scheduled additional-premium EFT draft |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove Flexible Premium Deferred Annuity | Yes | $100 | 28 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 3 | No | 0 (not applicable) | 28 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 5 | No | 0 (not applicable) | 28 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 6 | No | 0 (not applicable) | 28 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 7 | No | 0 (not applicable) | 28 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 10 | No | 0 (not applicable) | 28 |

## Tax registrations

Every tier may be issued as a non-qualified contract, a traditional IRA, a Roth IRA or a SEP IRA. A contract is registered as exactly one of these.

## Reading the schedule

- *Which tiers take additional premiums?* Only the Ashgrove Flexible Premium Deferred Annuity. On every SecureRate tier the initial premium is the only premium.
- *Does the IRA minimum differ from the non-qualified minimum?* On the Ashgrove Flexible Premium Deferred Annuity, yes ($2000 against $5000). On every SecureRate tier the two minimums are the same.
- *Example (hypothetical):* an owner aged 89 on the issue date is within the range of the Ashgrove SecureRate 3 and SecureRate 5 (highest issue age 90) but above the range of the SecureRate 6 and 7 (88) and of the SecureRate 10 and the Flexible Premium Deferred Annuity (85).
